entities.name: RecF (A8LVH1)
observations: The 376-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Salinispora arenicola RecF (UniProt A8LVH1); annotation links RecF to DNA replication/repair, ssDNA binding, ATP binding, and SOS response.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular weight 40.5 kDa; theoretical pI 7.87. These are computational estimates.
